description: Election Commission - Registration of Electors Act, No. 44 of 1980
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Election Commission under the Registration of Electors Act, No. 44 of 1980. It specifically cancels previous gazettes and appoints Registering Officers and Assistant Registering Officers for various Electoral Districts. The content focuses entirely on electoral administration matters - specifically the appointment of election officials responsible for voter registration processes. This falls squarely under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with electoral commission appointments and decisions related to electoral administration.
